text: Program Description Training Objectives The undergraduate major in supply chain management (international students) cultivates students who meet the needs of economic development, have a comprehensive development of morality, intelligence, physique, and aesthetics, have a high ideological and cultural cultivation, have a good innovative spirit and practical ability, have a solid foundation in foreign languages, mathematics, computer science, and a solid theoretical foundation in economics, management, information, systems science, and related disciplines, are familiar with policies and regulations in logistics and related industries, and master systematic circulation Theoretical knowledge of supply chain and supply chain management, capable of engaging in the operation and management of logistics enterprises, as well as the operation and management of cross-border logistics businesses in circulation and production enterprises.
